title: Don't Break the Cache: An Evaluation of Prompt Caching for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
authors: Elias Lumer; Faheem Nizar; Akshaya Jangiti; Kevin Frank; Anmol Gulati; Mandar Phadate; Vamse Kumar Subbiah
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving, LLM serving

problem_statement.en: Long-horizon agentic tasks span dozens of tool-calling API calls with context windows accumulating tens of thousands of tokens. Although OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google all offer prompt caching, no prior work quantifies its cost savings or compares caching strategies for multi-turn agentic workloads, where dynamic session-specific tool results interleave with static system prompts and naive full-context caching can paradoxically increase latency.
problem_statement.zh: 長程 agentic 任務跨越數十次 tool-calling API 呼叫，context window 累積達數萬 token。儘管 OpenAI、Anthropic 與 Google 皆提供 prompt caching，然而先前並無研究量化其於 multi-turn agentic workload 的成本節省，亦未比較各種 caching 策略；動態且 session 相依的 tool result 與靜態 system prompt 交錯，naive 的 full-context caching 甚至可能反而增加延遲。

key_innovation.en: A UUID-based cache-boundary control methodology that implements four controlled cache conditions against live provider APIs: No Cache (UUID prepended to the system prompt breaks all caching), Full Context (provider-automatic caching), System Prompt Only (UUID appended after the system prompt), and Exclude Tool Results (dual UUIDs after the system prompt and after each tool result). Evaluated with a LangChain Deep Agents web-search agent on DeepResearch Bench: 40 sessions per condition per model (500+ sessions total), 10,000-token system prompts, warmup calls to prime caches, >24h between conditions to let TTL-based cache entries expire, and independent-samples t-tests at alpha=0.05.
key_innovation.zh: 提出以 UUID 控制 cache boundary 的方法論，於實際 provider API 上實作四種受控 cache 條件：No Cache (於 system prompt 開頭前置 UUID 以破壞所有快取)、Full Context (provider 自動快取)、System Prompt Only (於 system prompt 之後附加 UUID)、Exclude Tool Results (於 system prompt 與每個 tool result 之後皆附加 UUID)。以 LangChain Deep Agents 建構 web-search agent，於 DeepResearch Bench 上每個模型每條件執行 40 個 session (合計逾 500 個 session)，system prompt 為 10,000 token；藉由 warmup 呼叫預先建立 cache，各條件間等待逾 24 小時使 TTL 到期，並以 independent-samples t-test (alpha=0.05) 檢定顯著性。

key_improvements.en: Prompt caching reduces API costs by 41-80% and improves TTFT by 13-31% across providers (best cache mode per model: GPT-5.2 79.6% cost / 13.0% TTFT; Claude Sonnet 4.5 78.5% / 22.9%; Gemini 2.5 Pro 41.4% / 6.1%; GPT-4o 45.9% / 30.9%). Cost savings are consistent across strategies (typically within 2-4 percentage points), but full-context caching can regress latency (GPT-4o TTFT -8.8%). Ablation: cost savings scale linearly with prompt size (10-45% at 500 tokens up to 54-89% at 50,000 tokens) and remain stable across 3-50 tool calls; below provider minimum caching thresholds, TTFT regresses 10-18%.
key_improvements.zh: Prompt caching 使 API 成本降低 41-80%，TTFT 改善 13-31% (各模型最佳 cache mode：GPT-5.2 成本 79.6% / TTFT 13.0%；Claude Sonnet 4.5 78.5% / 22.9%；Gemini 2.5 Pro 41.4% / 6.1%；GPT-4o 45.9% / 30.9%)。成本節省在各策略間一致 (通常差距僅 2-4 個百分點)，然而 full-context caching 可能使延遲倒退 (GPT-4o TTFT -8.8%)。Ablation 顯示成本節省隨 prompt size 線性擴展 (500 token 時 10-45%，50,000 token 時可達 54-89%)，且在 3-50 次 tool call 間保持穩定；低於 provider 最低快取門檻時，TTFT 反而倒退 10-18%。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (measurement study; significance via independent-samples t-tests at alpha=0.05, n=40 sessions per condition)
models_validated: GPT-5.2, GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Pro
validation_workloads: DeepResearch Bench (100 PhD-level research questions with real web-search tool calls), Synthetic ablation (prompt sizes 500-50,000 tokens; 3-50 tool calls)

scope_assumptions.en: Each session starts with a fresh context, so only within-session (not cross-session) cache benefits are measured. Single benchmark (DeepResearch Bench) and single agent framework (LangChain Deep Agents). Pricing (Table 3), minimum caching thresholds (1,024 tokens for OpenAI/Anthropic, 4,096 for Google), and TTL policies (5 minutes to 24 hours) reflect early-January-2026 provider documentation and are subject to change. Provider caching internals are black-box; TTFT exhibits natural variance from server load, geography, and provider infrastructure (ablation runs show higher variance than the main study). Authors advise practitioners to run experiments representative of their own workloads rather than relying solely on published benchmarks.
scope_assumptions.zh: 每個 session 皆以全新 context 開始，因此僅測量 session 內 (而非跨 session) 的快取效益。僅使用單一 benchmark (DeepResearch Bench) 與單一 agent 框架 (LangChain Deep Agents)。定價 (Table 3)、最低快取門檻 (OpenAI/Anthropic 為 1,024 token，Google 為 4,096 token) 與 TTL 政策 (5 分鐘至 24 小時) 依 2026 年 1 月初的 provider 文件為準，且可能變動。Provider 快取內部為 black-box；TTFT 受 server 負載、地理位置與 provider 基礎設施影響而有自然變異 (ablation 的變異高於主實驗)。作者建議實務者應以自身 workload 進行代表性實驗，而非僅依賴已發表的 benchmark 數據。
